    private static List<String> arr = new ArrayList<>();
    private static StringBuilder word = new StringBuilder();
    private static int cont = 0;
    private static int mayor = 0;
    private static boolean flg = false;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {

        int tam = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        for (int i = 0; i < tam; i++) {
            process(cad.charAt(i), i, tam);

        System.out.println(mayor + " " + arr.size());
    }
